{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue_clean'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Verify premises
print("Valid order_status values:", sales_df['order_status'].unique())
print("Valid order_type values:", sales_df['order_type'].unique())

# Apply filters: COMPLETED and not internal_test
completed_orders = sales_df[(sales_df['order_status'] == 'COMPLETED') & (sales_df['order_type'] != 'internal_test')]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Output
print(f"Total revenue from COMPLETED orders (excluding internal test): {total_revenue}")
